requirement.description: Data labeling is currently broken. That is simply how the data labeling process is set up today.
requirement.reading: That is simply how the data labeling process is set up today.

narrator.name: Data Dave
narrator.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

inputs.hint: The fact is that something does not exist. Describe only how the work is done today without it, as observed events or numbers. No consequences, risks, costs or benefits.

output.content: I am looking at the raw ingestion logs from the last three weeks. The annotation queue is empty because no workers have been assigned to the new batch. The incoming files sit in the staging bucket with no metadata tags attached. I checked the validation scripts, and they are not running against the unlabeled data. The model training job pulls directly from the raw storage path, bypassing the labeling stage entirely. There is no record of any human review or automated tagging step occurring between the data arrival and the model consumption. The pipeline simply moves the bytes from source to destination without any intermediate processing or quality checks on the labels themselves.
output.reclassify_reason: The text describes the current operational state of the data pipeline, specifically that the labeling stage is being bypassed and no quality checks are occurring, without expressing any wishes, refusals, or explicit trade-offs.
